design: Append a matched lexical contrast to the existing 22 examples. The general boundary was identified in earlier error analysis. IDs were fixed by reading the training split before the held-out text-only overlap check.

examples.label: prohibition
examples.role_zh: 给付方已明确禁止传送时，接收方须停止传送。条件限定一项被禁止的行为。

examples.label: definition
examples.role_zh: 在相关年度持续证明权益资本没有下降的范围和期间内，补税不发生。条件限定法律后果。

acceptance.population: All 426 test cases compared individually with frozen 22-shot predictions after collection
acceptance.target: Strictly higher prohibition F1 and fewer prohibition false positives
acceptance.permitted_sentence_label_changes: Only corrections of old errors involving prohibition as the old prediction or the gold class
acceptance.decision_unit: Whole experimental arm. Document every transition. No per-case model selection.
